title: Enshrouded
description: A voxel survival action RPG where you carve a home out of the fog-cursed kingdom of Embervale, solo or with up to 15 friends.
fun_fact: The 1.0 launch ends almost three years of early access and lands on PS5 the same day as PC.

title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
description: Asobo's Plague Tale prequel follows young Sophia uncovering the secrets of her past through stealth, swarming rats, and cinematic storytelling.
fun_fact: It launched day one on Xbox Game Pass with Play Anywhere support.
